KNOWLEDGE BASE (only the sections relevant to this ticket):
Printing & Quality
- In-house printing handles most orders. Overflow or specific formats go to Repro India or Epitome Books.
- Standard print turnaround: 5–7 business days from order confirmation.
- For a quality issue (misprints, binding defects, colour inconsistency), BookLeaf arranges a free reprint after verification. The author may need to share photos of the defective copy.

RESPONSE GUIDANCE FROM BOOKLEAF:
Example 1
Author: I received my author copies and the print quality is terrible. The images are blurry and pages are misaligned.
How to respond: Apologise sincerely. Ask for photos of the defective copies. Confirm a free reprint once verified. Give 5–7 business days for the reprint.
